patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes the banner and full-screen ads and skips the ad consent popup. The ad SDKs no longer start with the app, Firebase Analytics is turned off and the advertising ID permissions are removed. Notifications keep working.

patches.name: Word Finder overlay
patches.description: Adds a floating button on the game screen that opens a list of all possible moves.
